# test/fixtures — OFFLINE MOCK ISSUER KEYS (test only)

`mock-jwks.json` (public) and `mock-private.jwk.json` (private) are a **self-signed RS256
keypair generated by `scripts/mkkeys.mjs`**. They exist so the test suite can mint and
verify tokens fully **offline**, before the real World `client_id` / JWKS land.

**These are NOT secrets.** This key:
- signs nothing real — only synthetic demo tokens for `issuer=https://mock.trinity.local`;
- is not a World key and never touches any real World endpoint;
- is committed deliberately so `npm test` works on a fresh clone.

Any secret-scanner hit on `mock-private.jwk.json` is a **known, intentional false positive**.
Regenerate a fresh pair anytime with `npm run keys`. The real deployment uses the live
World JWKS (remote) and never a private key of ours (the pilot uses public-client/PKCE or
`private_key_jwt` — out of scope here).
